zh: 把元素依次放进若干条严格递减的序列，一个新值 x 只能接在末尾大于 x 的序列后面。为了给以后留余地，应当接在“末尾大于 x 且最小”的那一条上。
把各条序列的末尾值保持有序，用 upper_bound 二分找到第一个大于 x 的末尾：找到就把它替换为 x，找不到就新开一条。这和求最长非降子序列的贪心是同一个过程。
维护有序数组 tails。对每个 x，找第一个满足 tails[j] > x 的位置 j；若 j 等于长度就追加 x，否则令 tails[j]=x。最后 tails 的长度就是答案（也等于最长非降子序列的长度，这是下界）。
en: Put the elements one by one into strictly decreasing sequences; a new value x can only follow a sequence whose last value is greater than x. To keep options open for later, attach it to the sequence with the smallest such last value.

Keep the last values sorted and use an upper_bound binary search for the first one greater than x: replace it with x if found, otherwise start a new sequence. This is the same greedy as the one for the longest non-decreasing subsequence.

Maintain a sorted array tails. For each x find the first index j with tails[j] > x; if j equals the length append x, otherwise set tails[j]=x. The final length of tails is the answer, and it equals the length of the longest non-decreasing subsequence, which is a lower bound.

explanationEn:
## Idea

Keep the last values of all decreasing sequences in sorted order. A new value x is attached to the sequence whose last value is the smallest one greater than x; if there is none, start a new sequence. Update with an upper_bound binary search.

## Correctness

Among the sequences that can take x, choosing the smallest greater last value keeps the other, larger last values available for future elements; an exchange argument shows this is never worse. Equivalently, this maintains the smallest last values of the longest non-decreasing subsequences: the elements of such a subsequence must lie in different decreasing groups, and the number of groups used by the greedy reaches exactly this lower bound.

## Complexity

O(n log n) time, O(n) space.
